en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cylindrical medieval brick tower with a conical roof and a cross-topped spire. The tower stands at the end of a wet, reflective street bordered by multi‑story buildings. Small figures of pedestrians and an early 20th‑century car are visible. Below the image is a caption indicating the location and name of the tower.
